title: Board Resolution on Patronage — Declaration, Rates by Product Line and Allocation to the Member Equities & Patronage Surplus Classes
content:
Each December the board of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit declares patronage for the calendar year on the member's patronage-eligible loan volume, and allocates it to the Member Equities & Patronage allocated surplus classes and as cash.

## Resolved

1. **Earning loans.** A loan earns patronage for a year when it carried interest-bearing principal in that year; a loan in nonaccrual status on December 31 of the year, an EquipDirect Dealer Contract (which already carries a dealer-supported rate) and the interim period of a construction loan earn none.
2. **Allocation per loan.** For each earning loan the allocation is its eligible average daily balance for the year (from the year-end patronage run) times the rate declared for its line and year, divided by 100 and rounded to cents.
3. **Split by class.** The cash share of the allocation is declared as cash payable on the member's Qualified Allocated Surplus holding, the Qualified retained share of it is retained in Qualified Allocated Surplus, and the remainder — the Nonqualified retained share, absorbing any rounding cent — is retained in Nonqualified Allocated Surplus, each part rounded to cents and booked per loan with the loan's eligible average daily balance and rate, effective on the declaration date of the year.
4. **New holdings.** A member without an allocated surplus holding is subscribed to and issued one on the declaration date.
5. **Minimum.** When the member's allocations for the year total less than USD 5.00, nothing is allocated.
6. **Former borrowers.** A member whose loans have all been repaid still receives the allocation earned while they borrowed.

## Declared rates (% of eligible average daily balance) and declaration dates

| Patronage year | Operating Lines of Credit | Equipment & Vehicle Loans | Farm Real Estate Loans | Rural Home Loans | Construction Loans | Declared on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024 | 1.050 | 1.050 | 1.050 | 0.500 | 0.000 | 17 December 2024 |
| 2025 | 1.100 | 1.100 | 1.100 | 0.550 | 0.000 | 16 December 2025 |

Products excluded from patronage: EquipDirect Dealer Contract.

The cash and retained shares are those of the class schedule of patronage split (50 percent cash and 30 percent retained on Qualified Allocated Surplus, 20 percent retained on Nonqualified Allocated Surplus).

## Worked allocations (hypothetical loans, patronage year 2025)

| Loan | Eligible average daily balance | Rate | Allocation | Cash payable | Qualified retained | Nonqualified retained |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Farm Real Estate Loans | USD 250,000.00 | 1.100 | USD 2,750.00 | USD 1,375.00 | USD 825.00 | USD 550.00 |
| Rural Home Loans | USD 180,000.00 | 0.550 | USD 990.00 | USD 495.00 | USD 297.00 | USD 198.00 |

Each loan's allocation is booked separately, dated 16 December 2025. A member whose only earning loan had an eligible average daily balance of USD 400.00 at 1.100 percent has allocations totalling USD 4.40 for the year, below USD 5.00, and nothing is allocated.
